quests.name: Mushroom Picking
quests.hook: Gather a basket of mushrooms from the cave mouth before supper. What could possibly go wrong?

quests.name: The Whispering Shaft
quests.hook: The shaft exhales a sound like whispered names. You go down to find out whose.

quests.name: Gloomcap Hollow
quests.hook: Where the light fails, the mushrooms glow — and so do the eyes watching them.

quests.name: The Mycelium Warren
quests.hook: The tunnel walls are threaded with white filaments — and the filaments are listening.

quests.name: The Capfather
quests.hook: Something enormous stirs where the warren turns deepest. The mushrooms were only its fingers.

quests.name: Down the Rootwell
quests.hook: The cave's roots drop away into black water. You climb down anyway.

quests.name: The Blindstream
quests.hook: A river runs under the hill, and it runs the wrong way.

quests.name: Lantern Moss Grotto
quests.hook: The grotto glows with fireflies that should not exist this far underground.

quests.name: The Fungal Throne
quests.hook: The warren widens into a hall, and at its end sits a throne that was grown, not built.

quests.name: Mycelarch, the Rot Beneath
quests.hook: The throne is occupied. The thing on it has been waiting for someone to reach it.

quests.name: The Bramblegate
quests.hook: The road out of the valley is a wall of thorns now, and the thorns are moving.

quests.name: Wolf of the Green Trail
quests.hook: Something has been eating the woodcutters' dogs, and it is not a dog.

quests.name: The Thornsinger's Grove
quests.hook: The grove hums, and every branch leans toward you like an ear.

quests.name: Hornets of the High Meadow
quests.hook: The meadow's hornets have grown, and they have started keeping prisoners.

quests.name: The Thicket Tyrant
quests.hook: The thicket has a master. You can hear it breathing from the road.

quests.name: The Petrified Orchard
quests.hook: The orchard's trees turned to stone overnight. One thing in it didn't.

quests.name: Grove of the Hollow Stag
quests.hook: The stag's antlers are full of eyes, and every one is looking at you.

quests.name: The Antlered King's Hunt
quests.hook: You are the quarry now, and the hunt has already begun.

quests.name: The Withering Bloom
quests.hook: Where the bloom passes, the green goes grey.

quests.name: The Verdant Sovereign
quests.hook: The wilds have a king, and he does not want subjects. He wants soil.

quests.name: The Drowned Causeway
quests.hook: The old coast road is underwater now. So are the things that walk it.

quests.name: Saltmarsh Stalker
quests.hook: The reeds move against the wind.

quests.name: The Gilded Reef
quests.hook: A reef of treasure and teeth, and the tide is going out.

quests.name: Tidehollow Grotto
quests.hook: The cave fills with the tide. You have until it does.

quests.name: The Keeper of the Kelp
quests.hook: The kelp forest has a keeper, and it is very old.

quests.name: The Sinking Village
quests.hook: The village is going under, one house at a time.

quests.name: Blackwater Fen
quests.hook: The fen water is black and does not reflect you. That should worry you.

quests.name: The Lure-Lights
quests.hook: The lights on the water are beautiful. They are also a trap.

quests.name: The Sunken Chapel
quests.hook: A chapel sank with its congregation. The bells still ring.

quests.name: The Leviathan of the Deep
quests.hook: The coast has one master, and the tide goes where it is told.

quests.name: The Frostgate
quests.hook: The pass is closed by ice that grows while you watch.

quests.name: Whiteout Pass
quests.hook: In the whiteout you will meet yourself. Do not trust it.

quests.name: The Frozen Lake
quests.hook: The lake is solid. Something big is sleeping underneath it.

quests.name: Rime Hollow
quests.hook: Every breath hangs in the air here, frozen mid-cloud.

quests.name: The Ice-Warden
quests.hook: The Warden keeps the cold in — or keeps something else in with it.

quests.name: The Glasswood
quests.hook: The trees are glass, and they are full of trapped things.

quests.name: The Howling Glacier
quests.hook: The glacier howls, and the howl is getting closer.

quests.name: The Cave of Frozen Birds
quests.hook: Hundreds of birds hang frozen in the cave, and one of them just blinked.

quests.name: The Wintering Court
quests.hook: The frozen court holds session, and the courtiers have been waiting a very long time.

quests.name: The Hoarfrost Queen
quests.hook: Winter is not a season here. It is a ruler, and she has noticed you.

quests.name: Ashfall Field
quests.hook: Ash falls like grey snow, and beneath it the ground is warm.

quests.name: The Cinder Wood
quests.hook: The forest burned years ago and simply never stopped.

quests.name: Magma Shallows
quests.hook: The shallow water is boiling, and something is swimming in it.

quests.name: The Boiling Spring
quests.hook: The spring runs hot enough to strip bone, and something lives in it happily.

quests.name: The Forgebeast
quests.hook: The forge never stopped, and neither did what feeds it.

quests.name: The Obsidian Stair
quests.hook: A stair of black glass climbs into the smoke, and something is climbing down.

quests.name: The Ember Monkeys
quests.hook: The ember monkeys stole your supplies and are laughing about it.

quests.name: The Cinder Carnival
quests.hook: Someone built a carnival in the lava fields, and the rides are still running.

quests.name: The Caldera Rim
quests.hook: The rim is the only solid ground for miles, and it is cracking.

quests.name: Pyroclast, the Mountain's Heart
quests.hook: The mountain has a heart, and it has been beating for a thousand years. Tonight it wakes.

quests.name: Thunderclap Ridge
quests.hook: Every step on the ridge throws a spark, and something is walking the same path.

quests.name: The Static Meadow
quests.hook: The grass stands on end, and it stands on end because something is near.

quests.name: Voltstag's Herd
quests.hook: The herd moves as one animal, and one animal is looking at you.

quests.name: The Charged Chasm
quests.hook: The chasm hums with current, and the bridge across it is a single copper wire.

quests.name: The Stormherd Alpha
quests.hook: The herd has an alpha, and it has been saving the charge for you.

quests.name: The Lightning Stair
quests.hook: A stair of frozen bolts climbs into the clouds, and it does not look safe.

quests.name: The Besieged Beacon Tower
quests.hook: The tower's beacon has been dark for days. Someone took it, and someone is holding it.

quests.name: The Copper Aviary
quests.hook: A cage of copper wire hangs from the peak, and inside it, birds of lightning.

quests.name: The Conduit Spire
quests.hook: The spire drinks the storm and stores it. There's a sound like a held breath.

quests.name: Skybreaker, the Storm's Crown
quests.hook: The storm has a crown, and the crown has a keeper. The keeper is coming down.

quests.name: The Quarry Gate
quests.hook: The quarry closed decades ago. Today the gate is open.

quests.name: The Stonefall Gallery
quests.hook: The gallery ceilings shift every night, as if the mountain is chewing.

quests.name: The Boulder Run
quests.hook: A rolling boulder has run this track for a century, and it has learned to aim.

quests.name: The Termite Halls
quests.hook: The halls were carved by things with appetites bigger than their bodies.

quests.name: The Quarry Tyrant
quests.hook: Something runs the quarry. The workers left in a hurry and never came back.

quests.name: The Undergate Foundry
quests.hook: Below the quarry is a foundry, and its furnaces are still warm.

quests.name: The Court of Standing Stones
quests.hook: The stones were set in a circle long ago. Tonight they have turned slightly.

quests.name: The Grinding Deep
quests.hook: The deep grinds its teeth, and the sound never stops.

quests.name: The Earthheart Vault
quests.hook: The vault door is a mountain's face, and the mountain is frowning.

quests.name: Terravore, the Root of Mountains
quests.hook: The mountain's roots have a heart. Break it, and the mountain falls.

quests.name: The Grave Road
quests.hook: The road to the citadel is lined with graves, and the graves are opening.

quests.name: The Mist of the Marches
quests.hook: The mist is thick enough to walk on. It is also walking.

quests.name: The Gallows Orchard
quests.hook: The orchard's fruit hangs heavy, and none of it is fruit.

quests.name: The Crypt of Candles
quests.hook: The crypt is lit by candles that gutter when you lie.

quests.name: The Pale Rider
quests.hook: Something rides the march on a horse of smoke, and it is looking for a mount.

quests.name: The Legion of the Hollow Choir
quests.hook: You can hear them singing from a mile off. You should not be able to.

quests.name: The Widow's Court
quests.hook: The widow holds court in the dark, and her courtiers have all stopped moving.

quests.name: The Hunger Below
quests.hook: Something under the march is always hungry, and it has smelled you for miles.

quests.name: The Black Cathedral
quests.hook: The cathedral was built to something, and it is still open for worship.

quests.name: Umbragore, the Shadow Sovereign
quests.hook: The marches have a sovereign, and he has been expecting you since the grave road.

quests.name: The Spine Road
quests.hook: The road rides a dragon's spine, and the dragon is not as dead as it looks.

quests.name: Scales on the Ridge
quests.hook: The ridge sheds scales like leaves, and each one is bigger than a shield.

quests.name: The Hoard of Names
quests.hook: A hoard of coins, and every coin has a name on it. Yours is in there somewhere.

quests.name: The Wyrmsblood Fen
quests.hook: The fen runs red where the old wyrms bled, and it never dried.

quests.name: The Wyrmling Broodmother
quests.hook: The eggs are hatching, and the mother is right behind you.

quests.name: The Cradle of Coils
quests.hook: The cradle is a pit of coils, and they are all awake.

quests.name: The Broken Sky Temple
quests.hook: The temple was built to hold the sky up, its roof is gone, and the sky is falling.

quests.name: The Elder Wyrm's Court
quests.hook: The elder wyrm holds court, and its courtiers are the bones of everyone who has ever visited.

quests.name: The Last Egg
quests.hook: One egg remains, and it is warm. Something wants it back.

quests.name: Voragrim, the Dragon's Spine
quests.hook: The spine is not a road. It is a dragon, and it has been waiting for the citadel's call.

quests.name: The Citadel Gates
quests.hook: The gates open as you approach. That is not a welcome; it is a dare.

quests.name: The Ash Courtyard
quests.hook: The courtyard is ankle-deep in ash, and the ash remembers being people.

quests.name: The Hall of Broken Oaths
quests.hook: Every oath sworn in this hall broke, and the hall kept the pieces.

quests.name: The Screaming Gallery
quests.hook: The paintings scream. Do not look at them.

quests.name: The Warden of Nine Locks
quests.hook: Nine locks guard the inner keep. One warden guards the locks.

quests.name: The Throne Antechamber
quests.hook: The dark lord's throne is through the next door, and the antechamber is full of everyone who reached it first.

quests.name: The Court of Masks
quests.hook: Everyone at court wears a mask, and none of the masks are empty.

quests.name: The Hollow Chancellor
quests.hook: The dark lord's chancellor is a hollow suit of armor, and something is wearing it.

quests.name: The Dark Lord's Shadow
quests.hook: The dark lord's shadow got here first, and it is bigger than he is.

quests.name: The Dark Lord's Inner Chamber
quests.hook: The door closes behind you, the throne turns, and the dark lord has been waiting a very long time.
